name: Scott Wiener
stance: Author of SB 1047 and SB 53; wants binding catastrophic-risk safety rules on frontier developers and, after the 2026 OpenAI agent incident, a stronger SB 53.

statements.text: Authored SB 53, the Transparency in Frontier Artificial Intelligence Act, signed into law after his SB 1047 was vetoed in 2024.

We were called 'doomers' and 'decels,' and told that the risks we warned about were science fiction and not a serious risk we would see anytime soon. It turns out we were right, and the critics were wrong.
I believe this incident would have been covered by SB 1047 had it been signed into law, given the multiple state pathways to trigger the bill.
